claim_boundary: This certificate proves that the train-frozen galactic collector defines a single-valued constitutive function and a locally elliptic nonrelativistic scalar action for nonzero field. The operator becomes degenerately elliptic as the field tends to zero; this certificate does not prove global existence or uniqueness, derive the action from the five-dimensional Einstein-dilaton theory, establish a relativistic completion, or validate the response outside the exposed SPARC domain.
